svg.aria-label: Line chart. Coverage on the x axis from 0 to 100 %, accuracy on the answered subset on the y axis from 0 to 100 %. The gated system rises from 41.65 % at 100.00 % coverage to 74.04 % at 11.33 % coverage. A flat dashed line at 72.84 % is the most-frequent-sense baseline answering every instance; it is above the gated system at every measured point from 22.78 % coverage rightward, and that region is shaded. A second grey line is the same baseline restricted to whatever subset was answered, moving from 72.84 % to 64.05 % as coverage falls. Run ids: disambiguation.sdu21.abstention_curve, disambiguation.sdu21.most_frequent.
